messages:
maya: Heads-up: nightly-h100 on main is red, failing test_attention_kernel in quantized path. CI: https://ci.redwood/internal/rs/4821
sam: can you paste the failing log snippet? is this OOM or kernel error?
maya: quick paste:
```
E2026-02-14 02:45:12.341 kernel.cu:724] attention_kernel.cu: illegal memory access
E2026-02-14 02:45:12.342 runtime: cudaErrorIllegalAddress: an illegal memory access was encountered
E2026-02-14 02:45:12.343 backtrace: attention_forward -> launch_attention_kernel
```
Looks like the quantized attention kernel faults on step ~20 of the test.
diego: could be driver/CUDA mismatch or a recent kernel rewrite. We rolled driver to 535.86 two days ago — any flaky reports pinned to that?
maya: last successful nightly was at 1934400000, which used driver 535.54. I can try a rerun on the older driver but want to rule out code first.
charlie: @maya can you trigger a rerun? if it persists we should bisect commits touching attention/quant.
infra-ops-bot: rerun queued by maya (run id: 2026-4821-rerun-7). ETA ~5m :hourglass:
ci-bot: rerun finished: still failing, same illegal memory access in attention_kernel. (run id: 2026-4821-rerun-7)
sam: can you paste the failing test command so someone can reproduce locally?
maya: repro command:
```
bazel test //tests:attention_kernel_test --config=h100 --runs_per_test=1 --test_arg=--seed=42
export REDWOOD_QUANTIZE_LEVEL=2
```
diego: try toggling REDWOOD_QUANTIZE_LEVEL=1 to see if quant code path is responsible. also try setting REDWOOD_FORCE_CUDA=12.2 for a quick check.
charlie: since rerun stayed red, I'm happy to bisect. what's the commit window? maya: suspect range 7f3a1b2..c9d4e8f (last change was nonlinear attention rewrite + quant hooks). please kick off bisection when able.
diego: small suggestion: add `--gtest_filter=Attention*` to keep CI time down for local bisect.
ci-bot: quick CI observation: memory spike ~6.2Gi at failure time, not a classic OOM but illegal access after a memcpy.
maya: I'll start the bisect (local reproducer first). I'll post progress here and tag when I need someone to watch a bisect CI job. thanks all :pray:
charlie: thanks — ping me if you want me to run bisect CI or check kernel launches.
sam: also file a tiny flare to infra if the driver revert looks likely; keep nightly unblocked by temporarily disabling quant test if needed.
maya: noted. temporary test disable is last resort, proceeding with bisect now.
